name: Planet buy-order best-effort matching lifecycle
description: JSON protocol acceptance for unreserved placement, matching-time credit and capacity checks, partial fill, and durable cancellation.

tests.name: Setup: Admin
Setup: Planet market buyer
Read current planet buy-order expiry configuration
Set minimum valid buy-order expiry
Reject buy-order expiry below configured range
Reject buy-order expiry above configured range
Set 24-hour expiry for matching scenario
Grant Genesis device to create the test planet

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET genesis = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'planet_market_buyer_v3');

tests.name: Create buyer-owned planet
Choose a real port for the sell-side fixture

data.sql: SELECT port_id FROM ports ORDER BY port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Set buyer balance to zero before placing the unreserved order

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = 0 WHERE owner_type = 'player' AND owner_id = @{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Fill planet ORE storage before placing the unreserved order

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT 'planet', @{market_planet_id}, 'ORE', max_capacity FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id = @{market_planet_id} AND commodity = 'ORE' ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: Place best-effort order without credits or free storage
Verify order expiry is persisted using configured lifetime

data.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (expires_at - ts))::integer FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id = @{market_buy_order_id};

tests.name: Restore prior buy-order expiry configuration

data.note: Restore prior setting after acceptance test

tests.name: Provide funds and storage only after order placement

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = 250 WHERE owner_type = 'player' AND owner_id = @{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Free the destination planet storage before matching

data.sql: UPDATE entity_stock SET quantity = 0 WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id = @{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE';

tests.name: Seed ten units of seller stock and its account

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'ORE', 10) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 10;

tests.name: Ensure seller settlement account starts at zero

data.sql: INSERT INTO bank_accounts (owner_type, owner_id, currency, balance, is_active) VALUES ('port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'CRD', 0, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (owner_type, owner_id, currency) DO UPDATE SET balance = 0, is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Create an eligible sell order

data.sql: INSERT INTO commodity_orders (actor_type, actor_id, location_type, location_id, commodity_id, side, quantity, filled_quantity, price, status, ts, expires_at, cancellation_reason) SELECT 'port', @{market_seller_port_id}, 'port', @{market_seller_port_id}, commodities_id, 'sell', 10, 0, 100, 'open', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE' RETURNING commodity_orders_id;

tests.name: Make daily market settlement due

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_market_settlement';

tests.name: Wait for best-effort market settlement
Verify two-unit partial fill and unexecutable remainder cancellation

data.sql: SELECT status, filled_quantity, quantity - filled_quantity, cancellation_reason FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id = @{market_buy_order_id};

tests.name: Verify authoritative stock, credits, and trade settlement

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{market_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{market_seller_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE), (SELECT quantity FROM commodity_trades WHERE buyer_actor_type='player' AND buyer_actor_id=@{planet_market_buyer_v3_player_id} AND buyer_location_type='planet' AND buyer_location_id=@{market_planet_id} AND seller_location_type='port' AND seller_location_id=@{market_seller_port_id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1);
